scripts/player_actor.gd:
extends CharacterBody2D

var speed: float = 330.0
var jump_velocity: float = -760.0
var gravity: float = 1700.0
var facing_left: bool = false
var player_sprite: Sprite2D


func _ready() -> void:
	var tex: Texture2D = load("res://assets/normalized/player_sprite/player_idle.png")
	player_sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	player_sprite.texture = tex
	player_sprite.centered = true
	player_sprite.scale = Vector2(0.25, 0.25)
	player_sprite.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR
	add_child(player_sprite)

	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	var rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
	rect.size = Vector2(34.0, 68.0)
	shape.shape = rect
	add_child(shape)

	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 6.0
	floor_max_angle = 0.0


func update_movement(delta: float) -> void:
	var input_dir: float = Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	velocity.x = input_dir * speed
	velocity.y += gravity * delta
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and is_on_floor():
		velocity.y = jump_velocity
	move_and_slide()
	if not is_zero_approx(velocity.x):
		if velocity.x < 0.0:
			facing_left = true
		else:
			facing_left = false
	player_sprite.flip_h = facing_left
